{{Current events|year=2019|month=04|day=4|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)]], [[Timeline of the Libyan Civil War (2014–present)#April_2019,_Western_Libya_Offensive|2019 Western Libya Offensive]]
**[[Libyan National Army]] forces continue to advance on the [[Libya]]n capital [[Tripoli]], capturing the city of [[Gharyan]], with only light resistance reported. General [[Khalifa Haftar]] has ordered the LNA to seize control of Tripoli, prompting the Tripoli-based [[Presidential Council (Libya)|Presidential Council]] to declare a general mobilization. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/04/un-chief-urges-restraint-as-libyan-army-leader-plans-tripoli-assault (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20190404-libya-declares-mobilization-to-face-haftars-forces/ (''Middle East Monitor'')]

;Art and culture
*[[Belarus]]ian authorities begin demolishing crosses with bulldozers at the [[Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic]]-era [[mass grave]] site [[Kurapaty]] on the outskirts of [[Minsk]], where at least 30,000 people were executed by the [[NKVD]]'s [[secret police]] in the 1930s and 1940s. The bulldozing is widely condemned in Belarus. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-47816897 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Boeing 737 MAX groundings]], [[Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302]]
**The Ethiopian government releases a preliminary report on the investigation into the crash of [[Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-news/ethiopian-airlines-flight-302-crash-preliminary-report-today-live-updates-04-04-2019/ (CNN)]
*A rapidly spreading [[wildfire]] in [[Gangwon Province, South Korea|Gangwon Province]], [[South Korea]], kills two people, injures 11 others, and forces the evacuation of thousands of civilians. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/south-korean-coastal-fire-kills-one-injures-11/2019/04/04/8538804c-56f7-11e9-aa83-504f086bf5d6_story.html?noredirect=on&utm_term=.032a40dcb12b (''The Washington Post'')]


;Law and crime
*Aftermath of the [[Christchurch mosque shootings]], [[Internet censorship in Australia]]
**The [[Australian Parliament]] passes a law which makes it illegal for Internet platforms and service providers to host videos of "abhorrent violent conduct" without "expeditiously" removing them. [https://www.theguardian.com/media/2019/apr/04/australia-passes-social-media-law-penalising-platforms-for-violent-content (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Cannabis in Guam]]
**[[List of Governors of Guam|Governor]] [[Lou Leon Guerrero]] signs a bill into law, legalizing the recreational use of [[Cannabis (drug)|cannabis]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/healthcare/437440-guam-legalizes-marijuana (''The Hill'')]
